title: Beast2Py
notes: Beast2Py is distributed as MIT AND LGPL-2.1-only: the Python package itself is MIT, and the bundled BEAST2 package-management helper classes are LGPL-2.1-only (see NOTICE and LICENSE.BEAST2-LGPL-2.1.txt in beast2py/tools).
description: Beast2Py is a Python framework for reproducible divergence time estimation with BEAST2: declarative YAML configuration, calibration prior specification and conflict detection, three-gate validation, prior sensitivity analysis, analysis fingerprints, generated LaTeX methods descriptions, and pipeline generation. Beast2Py is distributed as MIT AND LGPL-2.1-only: the Python package itself is MIT, and the bundled BEAST2 package-management helper classes remain LGPL-2.1 (see NOTICE and LICENSE.BEAST2-LGPL-2.1.txt in beast2py/tools).
